title: Genghis Khan to SpongeBob in six links
description: Five Great Khans, two pages of a medieval Marco Polo manuscript, 82 popes, the Obamas and a London soccer drill connect Genghis Khan to SpongeBob SquarePants.
hook: How is Genghis Khan connected to SpongeBob SquarePants?

links.line: Genghis Khan founded the Mongol Empire, and his grandson Kublai became its fifth Great Khan.
A 15th-century French manuscript painted Kublai Khan receiving the Venetian merchant brothers Niccolò and Maffeo Polo.
The same book paints the Polos with Pope Gregory X, who sent them back to Kublai in 1271.

links.line: From Gregory X, the 184th pope, the line runs unbroken to the 266th, Pope Francis.

image.file: File:Pope Francis and the Obamas at the White House.jpg

links.line: In 2015, Barack and Michelle Obama welcomed Pope Francis to the White House.
And in 2012 in London, Michelle Obama kicked a goal past SpongeBob, with David Beckham cheering.
